releaseNotes:
Add debug-only "Ignore errors" toggle to suppress health-gate overlay

Lets the kiosk UI (including the idle slideshow) be exercised on an
emulator without real hardware by hiding the IdleUnavailableScreen
health-gate overlay (control board / water module offline, water low).

Double-gated for safety: the toggle only appears in the debug-only
Developer settings section, and its effect is additionally
BuildConfig.DEBUG-gated at the render site, so a release build can never
hide a real fault from a customer.

Strings added to AdminStringsCore (ko/en); flag persisted in DataStore.
